note: Local source-only identities for Postman Editing, AI/keyed-save and provisional import requests outside the 141-row TC-API catalogue; not owner acceptance or personal skill evidence.

selector.name: PATCH /transactions/:id 200, only the field sent changes

records.oracleReason: PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions/{{editTx}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "amount_cents": 2500 }; checks=expectOk(200, 'transaction'); assertions=the amount changed / the note was NOT touched, because PATCH is partial (D-029).

PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions/{{editTx}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "note": null }; checks=expectOk(200, 'transaction'); assertions=the note is null, and null is a legal value for it / the amount survived a patch that did not mention it.

selector.name: PATCH /transactions/:id an empty body is 400, not a 200 that did nothing

records.oracleReason: PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions/{{editTx}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={}; checks=expectError(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED'); assertions=the message says a field is needed.

selector.name: PATCH /transactions/:id a server-owned field is rejected, not ignored

records.oracleReason: PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions/{{editTx}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "schedule_id": 1 }; checks=expectError(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED'); assertions=it names the field rather than silently dropping it (D-029).

selector.name: PATCH /transactions/:id an unknown field is rejected

records.oracleReason: PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions/{{editTx}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "colour": "red" }; checks=expectError(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED'); assertions=status/schema only.

selector.name: PATCH /transactions/:id the create-path validators still apply

records.oracleReason: PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions/{{editTx}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "amount_cents": 0 }; checks=expectError(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED'); assertions=zero is refused on edit exactly as on create.

PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions/{{editTx}}; auth={"type":"bearer","bearer":[{"key":"token","value":"{{tokenB}}","type":"string"}]}; body={ "amount_cents": 100 }; checks=expectError(404, 'NOT_FOUND'), expectNotForbidden(); assertions=status/schema only.

selector.name: PATCH /transactions/:id a row that does not exist is 404

records.oracleReason: PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions/99999999; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "amount_cents": 100 }; checks=expectError(404, 'NOT_FOUND'); assertions=status/schema only.

PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/schedules/{{editSched}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "name": "Renamed loan", "amount_cents": 20000 }; checks=expectOk(200, 'schedule'); assertions=name and amount changed together / remaining_cents is recomputed from the new amount, never stored.
PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/schedules/{{editSched}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "paid_count": 99 }; checks=expectError(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED'); assertions=a counter cannot be set by hand (D-029).
PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/schedules/{{editSched}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "active": 0 }; checks=expectError(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED'); assertions=status/schema only.

selector.name: PATCH /schedules/:id total_count 0 is bad input, before state is considered

records.oracleReason: PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/schedules/{{editSched}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "total_count": 0 }; checks=expectError(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED'); assertions=zero is refused as INPUT, so it never reaches the state check.

selector.name: PATCH /schedules/:id raising total_count reopens a finished loan

records.oracleReason: PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/schedules/{{editSched}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "total_count": 6 }; checks=expectOk(200, 'schedule'); assertions=active is DERIVED from the counts, not preserved (D-029).

selector.name: PATCH /schedules/:id total_count below paid_count is 409, not 400

records.oracleReason: PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/schedules/{{editSched}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "total_count": 1 }; checks=expectError(409, 'CONFLICT'); assertions=a valid integer that conflicts with state is 409, not 400.

selector.name: PATCH /schedules/:id total_count equal to paid_count finishes it

records.oracleReason: PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/schedules/{{editSched}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "total_count": 3 }; checks=expectOk(200, 'schedule'); assertions=finished, reached from the other direction than the last payment.

selector.name: PATCH /schedules/:id/pay a loan finished by editing cannot be paid

records.oracleReason: PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/schedules/{{editSched}}/pay; auth=inherited bearer; body=none; checks=expectError(409, 'CONFLICT'); assertions=the state machine does not care how it reached finished.

selector.name: PATCH /schedules/:id day_of_month 32 is refused on edit too

records.oracleReason: PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/schedules/{{editSched}}; auth=inherited bearer; body={ "day_of_month": 32 }; checks=expectError(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED'); assertions=status/schema only.

PATCH {{baseUrl}}/api/schedules/{{editSched}}; auth={"type":"bearer","bearer":[{"key":"token","value":"{{tokenB}}","type":"string"}]}; body={ "name": "stolen" }; checks=expectError(404, 'NOT_FOUND'), expectNotForbidden(); assertions=status/schema only.
GET {{baseUrl}}/api/ai/capabilities; auth=inherited bearer; body=none; checks=expectStatus(200); assertions=the off-mode capability shape, exactly.

POST {{baseUrl}}/api/ai/expense-draft; auth={"type":"noauth"}; headers=[{"key":"Content-Type","value":"application/json"}]; body={ "text": "Lunch 9 EUR", "reference_date": "{{aiToday}}", "locale": "auto" }; prerequest=// The server compares reference_date and keyed spent_on with its own local day. const d = new Date(); const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); pm.collectionVariables.set('aiTo; checks=expectError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED'); assertions=status/schema only.

POST {{baseUrl}}/api/ai/expense-draft; auth=inherited bearer; headers=[{"key":"Content-Type","value":"application/json"}]; body={ "text": "Lunch 9 EUR", "reference_date": "{{aiToday}}", "locale": "auto", "provider": "demo" }; prerequest=// The server compares reference_date and keyed spent_on with its own local day. const d = new Date(); const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); pm.collectionVariables.set('aiTo; checks=expectError(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED'); assertions=status/schema only.

POST {{baseUrl}}/api/ai/expense-draft; auth=inherited bearer; headers=[{"key":"Content-Type","value":"application/json"}]; body={ "text": "Lunch 9 EUR", "reference_date": "{{aiToday}}", "locale": "auto", "consent_to_external_processing": true }; prerequest=// The server compares reference_date and keyed spent_on with its own local day. const d = new Date(); const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); pm.collectionVariables.set('aiTo; checks=expectError(503, 'AI_UNAVAILABLE'); assertions=the message points to manual entry.

POST {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions; auth=inherited bearer; headers=[{"key":"Content-Type","value":"application/json"},{"key":"Idempotency-Key","value":"{{aiKey}}"}]; body={ "amount_cents": 1800, "category_id": {{catA}}, "spent_on": "{{aiToday}}", "note": "keyed lunch" }; prerequest=// The server compares reference_date and keyed spent_on with its own local day. const d = new Date(); const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); pm.collectionVariables.set('aiTo; checks=expectOk(201, 'transaction'); assertions=a first save is not a replay.

selector.name: POST /transactions same key, same payload → 201 replay, same row

records.oracleReason: POST {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions; auth=inherited bearer; headers=[{"key":"Content-Type","value":"application/json"},{"key":"Idempotency-Key","value":"{{aiKey}}"}]; body={ "note": "keyed lunch", "spent_on": "{{aiToday}}", "category_id": {{catA}}, "amount_cents": 1800 }; checks=expectOk(201, 'transaction'); assertions=marked as a replay / the same expense, not a second one.

POST {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions; auth=inherited bearer; headers=[{"key":"Content-Type","value":"application/json"},{"key":"Idempotency-Key","value":"{{aiKey}}"}]; body={ "amount_cents": 1900, "category_id": {{catA}}, "spent_on": "{{aiToday}}", "note": "keyed lunch" }; checks=expectError(409, 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'); assertions=status/schema only.

POST {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions; auth=inherited bearer; headers=[{"key":"Content-Type","value":"application/json"},{"key":"Idempotency-Key","value":"qa-no-date-{{runId}}"}]; body={ "amount_cents": 1800, "category_id": {{catA}} }; checks=expectError(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED'); assertions=status/schema only.

POST {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions; auth=inherited bearer; headers=[{"key":"Content-Type","value":"application/json"},{"key":"Idempotency-Key","value":"short"}]; body={ "amount_cents": 1800, "category_id": {{catA}}, "spent_on": "{{aiToday}}", "note": "keyed lunch" }; checks=expectError(400, 'VALIDATION_FAILED'); assertions=status/schema only.
DELETE {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions/{{aiKeyedTx}}; auth=inherited bearer; body=none; checks=expectStatus(204), expectNoBody(); assertions=status/schema only.

selector.name: POST /transactions with a body over the parser limit → 413, not 500 (BUG-019)

records.oracleReason: POST {{baseUrl}}/api/transactions; auth=inherited bearer; headers=[{"key":"Content-Type","value":"application/json"}]; body={ "amount_cents": 1, "note": "{{bigNote}}" }; prerequest=pm.collectionVariables.set('bigNote', 'x'.repeat(120 * 1024));; checks=expectError(413, 'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE'); assertions=status/schema only.

POST {{baseUrl}}/api/imports/confirm; auth=inherited bearer; body={"source":"synthetic-demo-v1","records":[{"external_id":"newman-{{runId}}","amount_cents":3500,"spent_on":"{{importToday}}","category_name":"{{catAName}}","note":"Synthetic example"}]}; checks=expectStatus(200); assertions=retry uses the same transaction.
